name: Itharius's Cave
summary: Green whelps roam the marsh around Itharius's Cave, where Itharius keeps watch. The cave lies among the far southwestern cliffs of the Swamp of Sorrows.

sections.title: A Hermit Among Whelps
sections.body: Green whelps wander the mire outside Itharius's Cave in the southwestern Swamp of Sorrows. Itharius lives in the damp cavern, far from civilization. He appears to be a high elf, a people rarely found alone in these southern swamps. He keeps watch over the young dragonkin as they grow, sharing their remote home.

faq.answer: Itharius lives in the cave, apart from civilization, and watches over the local dragonkin. He appears to be a high elf.
Itharius's Cave lies in the far southwestern Swamp of Sorrows, against the mountain ridges south of the main road.

faq.q: Why are there green whelps outside the cave?
faq.answer: Green whelps live in the surrounding marsh. Itharius watches over and protects the unruly young dragons as they grow.

faq.q: Why would a high elf live out in the swamp?
faq.answer: Itharius appears to be a high elf, a people rarely seen in these southern bogs. He remains in the swamp to safeguard its green dragonkin, living alone in his remote den.

angles.text: Green dragonkin in the swamp may interest you as a druid. Your traditions are tied to the Green Dragonflight and the Emerald Dream.
